leakage_demo.warning: NOT REPORTABLE. Spatially autocorrelated pixels appear in both train and test. Included only to quantify the inflation this produces relative to leave-one-site-out (proposal §5.1 mitigation 6).

caveat: All figures are from SIMULATED scenes at species contrast 1.0. They validate the pipeline and the validation methodology, not Hong Kong field separability, which is unmeasured (proposal Appendix B.5) and is what Phase 0 buys.
